searchText: Eth can save 50-100+++ bytes in complex txs if some sol design choices were adopted. Just a matter of priorities. The people who design and build Solidity (and the ABI it uses) are different from the people authoring the core protocol. Not talking about solidity — this is tx design Check out https://solana.com/docs/core/transactions Lots of cool engineering choices If you think there is a good opportunity to reduce bytes used by the protocol it is probably worth discussing as a proposal. A question that will certainly come up is how much it will affect Ethereum across the board, so something that only impacts 0.1% of transactions that land on the network is less likely to get support than something that helps 99% of transactions.
